text: Which statement about the based loop space ΩA = (a =_A a) is correct in HoTT?
choices: ΩA has the structure of a group object in types (up to homotopy)
explanation: ΩA = (a=_A a) is the type of loops at a. It has group structure: identity=refl, multiplication=concatenation, inverse=path reversal. It is the loop space — group structure holds up to homotopy.
